assets.title: 归航号：承力结构与可成长的家
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Redraw the provided early Blender spaceship as a sophisticated industrial-design sketchbook exploration sheet for an original space exploration game, Stellar Echoes. This is a concept HAND-DRAWN development sheet, not a cinematic frame or finished 3D render. Preserve the source's long integrated central spine, narrow pointed front and broader swept-back shoulders. Develop the form with convincing load paths, layered maintainable plates, recessed service seams, warm ceramic inserts, clean functional negative space and restrained blue-gray alloy. It is a long-distance civilian ark, a growing home, not a fighter or military cruiser. Preserve only the BASIC HULL in the reference. No later-added solar wings, cargo crane, refinery, habitat towers, antenna array or add-on modules.
Landscape large high-resolution sheet on clean warm off-white paper. Confident dark graphite, precise fine ink construction lines, cool gray and muted blue marker wash, sparse warm ochre. A large carefully drawn front-three-quarter hull study dominates center-left. Along the bottom, 3 smaller silhouette studies vary only panel hierarchy and shoulder section, not overall architecture; label only A, B, C. At right a legible stern study: TWO large hollow main engine nozzles separated by one recessed central docking pocket, ONE smaller auxiliary nozzle below the pocket. Show actual solid supports. The docking pocket is not a fourth engine, not a glowing portal, not a flight deck. Small isolated material/joint detail at top right, safety handle and removable service panel show maintainability. Long unbroken readable planes and rhythm of big/medium/small parts; avoid noisy greeble and thick toy-like rounded panels. The base ark is about 218 m long, 84 m wide; use tiny window strips to imply real scale without printing dimensions. Designed, practical and memorable; simple sparse arrow callouts. Title only “01 / ARK — FORM STUDIES”. No paragraphs, pseudo handwriting, watermarks, logos, planets, combat, fog, lens flare or backdrop. These are alternate surface interpretations of the same ship, not three new ships.

assets.title: 三种值守职责：空间站设计语言
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transform the THREE provided original Blender station references into one premium architectural/industrial sci-fi concept SKETCH SHEET. Reference 1 is the supply platform, 2 the greenhouse, 3 the archive. Keep these as separate functional families, tied together by a shared civilization of maintainable ports and public services. Refine their elegance and functional detail. Do not copy existing game IP. This is a design manuscript, not a film shot, poster or toy render.
Landscape high-resolution clean ivory paper, confident graphite and fine pen lines, loose construction lines, careful gray marker washes, restrained desaturated blue-gray/ceramic/ochre accents. Editorial layout THREE EQUAL COLUMNS with clear whitespace gutters. Each column: one large floating three-quarter structural sketch, one tiny silhouette, one magnified physical service/detail sketch. The drawings should look hand-developed by a skilled hard-surface concept designer. Simple titles only: “02 / DUTY STATIONS”, then “SUPPLY”, “CULTIVATION”, “RECORD”.
LEFT SUPPLY: axial freight spine with TWO BROKEN OPEN C-shaped freight cradles and exposed racks; one sealed damaged branch, one protected maintained public docking interface. Real broken strut ends, no closed decorative rings. Detail: clean mating face and manual emergency water connection mounted in a worn enclosure, blank handover record slot. People are absent.
CENTER CULTIVATION: SIX independent elongated pressurized cultivation pods arranged radially around central core, protected segmented glass, practical ribs and isolation bulkheads. Clearly distinguish sealed seed storage from sparse active growing racks; modest plants behind glass, not a jungle or green glow. Include small end-on diagram clearly showing six pods for count verification. Detail: a removable seed cartridge with a physical destination tag.
RIGHT RECORD: protected dense armored record core with fine OFF-CENTER observation arcs and an off-axis optical instrument, asymmetric lightweight service structures attached mechanically. No magic orbital rings or gyroscopic spinning core. Detail: replaceable calibrated data cassette and worn external instrument mount. Protect the core, show selectively degraded outer mechanism.
All three share interchangeable hand-sized service connectors, repair panel joints and small amber safety inserts. Light is subordinate to readable design, cyan only at an actual interface. Clear functional silhouette differentiation even in monochrome. Draw structures in weightlessness: no ground base, feet, terrestrial roof, city, asteroid, planetary backdrop, glowing aura, wide decorative neon or text blocks. Historical wear must concentrate on contact edges and replacement panels, not uniform rust.

assets.title: 给下一班人留下的东西
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original hand-drawn industrial prop design manuscript sheet for Stellar Echoes, a game about a small human crew reconnecting abandoned public space stations. The civilization preserves usable interfaces and predecessor records. Draw FIVE precise functional artifacts with delightful human specificity, on ivory paper, in graphite, fine ink and gray marker with restrained desaturated blue-gray metal, warm off-white washable inserts and ochre safety tabs. Landscape high-resolution editorial design sheet, asymmetrical but orderly layout, generous whitespace, clear large drawings and a few exploded detail studies. Sophisticated practical sci-fi: repairable, gloved use, long service life; not fantasy, steampunk, weapon props, retro distressed parchment or a cluttered mood board.
Largest central drawing: PUBLIC HANDOVER PANEL in a removable maintenance hatch, flat replaceable writing strips held by mechanical clips, old entries as a few abstract dashes, the LAST FIELD PROMINENTLY EMPTY awaiting the next keeper; no readable invented dates or messages. Detail study shows how an old strip is retained under the new one.
Top left: engineer's shallow fold-out TOOL CASE with 4-5 specific restrained tools in tethered contact-worn sockets; beside it an EMPTY one-person meal tray, an intentionally reserved place on the workbench, one subtly replaced differently-colored latch.
Top right: SEED TRANSIT CASE: robust small outer frame around separately removable sealed seed cartridges, narrow inspection windows, attached physical provenance/destination tag with four fields represented as layout rules, one field has an old retained strip. Dry seeds, no fresh vegetables.
Bottom left: one STANDARD CARGO RACK cell, empty but with one slim drawer of old punched cargo tags sorted behind a new front tag. The shared clamp fitting visibly echoes the seed case fitting.
Bottom right: close-up EMERGENCY WATER OUTLET, gloved manual valve, protected shared quick connector with tethered cap, worn exterior but carefully maintained clean sealing face; simple water path symbol, no paywall or access lock.
Title only “03 / THINGS LEFT FOR THE NEXT WATCH”. Label objects simply 01 through 05, no other words, fake handwriting, dimensions, Cyrillic, watermark or brand logos. Use construction lines and restrained arrows to connect mechanisms, not storytelling captions. Every item should be immediately drawable as a Blender prop, with coherent joints, plausible wall thickness and useful handholds. Let service history show through kept records and selective repairs, not generalized grime.
